description: Retrieve an ad via GET request. Same parameters as serve_ad but uses GET instead of POST.

_abdk_json.description: Data key key-value pairs for data key targeting

ip.description: IPv4 address for geographic targeting (required for server-side requests)

pid.description: Page ID for unique delivery/roadblocks (random number, same for all zones on page)

place.description: Place counter for unique delivery (0, 1, 2, etc.)

referrer.description: Page URL for URL targeting (required for server-side requests)

rf.description: Pass 1 to include is_redirectable field in response

setID.description: Zone ID to serve an ad from

spr.description: Screen pixel ratio for platform targeting

type.description: Response type: "json" for most eligible ad, "jsonr" for all eligible ads ranked

ua.description: User agent string for platform targeting

name: get_ad
